{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low during uptrends, showing significant lag that creates profitable long bias",
    "When sentiment turns positive (score > 0.5), model under-forecasts prices by 0.5-2.0 compared to true outcomes",
    "Mean reversion bias in model - prices diverge most when trend is strong, then model rushes toward mean ignoring momentum",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast error magnitude: higher sentiment scores (0.67-1.00) yield 20-50% larger deviations",
    "Model over-forecasts in downticks but never as aggressively as it under-forecasts in upticks",
    "The forecast error follows a clear pattern: early days of the 30d horizon show 30-50% larger errors than later days as prices converge"
] }
